sources.title: ProCreations/BetterWright-K2-Horizon-7B-Uno · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Diffusion adapter (adapter/): the released K2-Horizon-7B-Uno conditional LoRA, unchanged. Uno's Ψ-Spec sampler verifies every drafted block against the AR weights, so generation quality is exactly that of the fine-tuned AR model; the adapter only changes speed.

sources.snippet: K2 Horizon 7B is IFM's Apache-2.0 dense model released 3 September 2026: 7B parameters, a 512K context window, single-GPU serving and a published training record.
